package.description: 面向多渠道、多凭据场景的自托管 AI 网关

en-US.description: A self-hosted AI gateway for multi-channel, multi-credential setups
en-US.longDescription:
Consolidate API keys, subscription accounts, traffic scheduling, fault handling, request logs, and usage statistics into a single entry point.

Why choose GPT-Load

Applications only need to configure one address and one AccessKey. All backend providers, accounts, credentials, models, and routing strategies are managed entirely within the administrative interface.
- Unified Entrance, Native Protocol Retention — Centrally manage official APIs, cloud platforms, model services, and compatible relays; clients continue using native OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini interfaces without any code modifications.
- Unified Management of API Keys & Subscriptions — Subscription channels like Codex, Claude, Antigravity, and Grok share the same credential management, scheduling, and health systems as API Key channels.
- Built-in Scheduling & Fault Isolation — Multi-credential scheduling, automatic weighting, retries, cooldowns, blacklisting, and session affinity reduce the impact of individual credential overload or failure.
- Observable, Easy to Deploy, Data Self-hosting — Provides health monitoring, routing, logs, usage, and cost estimation; a single Go binary with an embedded management UI, supporting SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and local credential encryption.

Support Scope

Client Protocols

| Protocol                | Main Endpoint              |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------- |
| OpenAI Chat Completions | POST /v1/chat/completions  |
| OpenAI Responses        | /v1/responses & resource paths |
| OpenAI Images           | POST /v1/images/...        |
| OpenAI Embeddings       | POST /v1/embeddings        |
| Anthropic Messages      | POST /v1/messages          |
| Gemini                  | /v1beta/models/...         |

Each channel explicitly declares its executable protocols and capabilities. GPT-Load performs conversions between supported capabilities but is not a universal converter for arbitrary protocols or JSON.
In the initial phase, Embeddings are only provided via native OpenAI-compatible Wire through OpenAI, OpenRouter, and OpenAI Compatible API Key channels; they are not supported for subscription channels or protocol cross-conversion. AccessKeys without protocol filters will allow all enabled protocols by default and will gain Embeddings access after upgrading; for least-privilege deployment, please explicitly configure protocol filters.

Built-in Channels

- Official & Cloud Platforms: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI
- Popular Model Services: DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, SiliconFlow, Zhipu AI, Alibaba, Volcengine, OpenRouter, Groq
- Subscription Channels: Codex, Claude, Antigravity, Grok
- Custom: OpenAI Compatible (any compatible relay)

zh-CN.description: 面向多渠道、多凭据场景的自托管 AI 网关
zh-CN.longDescription:
把 API Key、订阅账号、流量调度、故障处理、请求日志与用量统计，收进同一个入口。

为什么选择 GPT-Load

应用只需要配置一个地址和一个 AccessKey。后面的服务商、账号、凭据、模型与路由策略，全部在管理界面里完成。
- 统一入口，保留原生协议 — 官方 API、云平台、模型服务和兼容中转统一管理；客户端继续使用 OpenAI、Anthropic 或 Gemini 原生接口，无需改造代码。
- 统一管理 API Key 与订阅账号 — Codex、Claude、Antigravity、Grok 等订阅渠道与 API Key 渠道共享凭据管理、调度和健康体系。
- 内置调度与故障隔离 — 多凭据调度、自动权重、重试、冷却、黑名单与会话亲和，降低单个凭据过载或失效的影响。
- 可观测、易部署、数据自持 — 提供健康、路由、日志、用量与成本估算；单个 Go 二进制内嵌管理界面，支持 SQLite、MySQL、PostgreSQL 和本地凭据加密。

支持范围

客户端协议

| 协议                    | 主要入口                   |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------- |
| OpenAI Chat Completions | POST /v1/chat/completions  |
| OpenAI Responses        | /v1/responses 及其资源路径 |
| OpenAI Images           | POST /v1/images/...        |
| OpenAI Embeddings       | POST /v1/embeddings        |
| Anthropic Messages      | POST /v1/messages          |
| Gemini                  | /v1beta/models/...         |

每个渠道会明确声明自己可执行的协议与能力。GPT-Load 在受支持的能力之间做转换，但不是任意协议、任意 JSON 的通用转换器。
Embeddings 首期只在 OpenAI、OpenRouter 和 OpenAI Compatible API Key 渠道提供原生 OpenAI-compatible Wire，不支持订阅渠道或协议互转。未设置协议过滤器的 AccessKey 会按既有语义允许全部已启用协议，升级后也会获得 Embeddings 访问能力；最小权限部署请显式配置协议过滤器。

内置渠道

- 官方与云平台：OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、xAI、Azure OpenAI、AWS Bedrock、Google Vertex AI
- 常用模型服务：DeepSeek、Moonshot AI、SiliconFlow、Zhipu AI、Alibaba、Volcengine、OpenRouter、Groq
- 订阅渠道：Codex、Claude、Antigravity、Grok
- 自定义：OpenAI Compatible（任意兼容中转）
